messages:
mira: Thanks for coming to today's all-hands \u2014 recording + slides: https://redwood.example.com/ah/177300 (rec) and https://redwood.example.com/slides/q2-brief.pdf :link:
mira: Quick follow-ups I'm tracking from the live Q&A: 1) Startup credits/pricing clarification, 2) Dedicated rollback & fallback plan, 3) demo streaming glitch root cause, 4) action owners for partner comms.
leah: on Dedicated rollback 1: we have an explicit fallback to the previous non-quantized variant; infra will run a rollback drill during the canary window.
nash: small note 1: demo streaming hiccup during the live demo 1: logs show a transient tokenization error in the staging model. infra + eng-runtime to investigate and publish a short postmortem.
nash: tagging @jon for the rollback drill coordination.
jon: got it, I'll schedule the rollback drill for Wed 9am PT and post a short runbook in #eng-runtime. success = ability to rollback within 5m and no client errors for 30m.
mira: pricing/startup credits Q: will we extend the previous promo to new signups?
leah: decision: extend 3-month startup credits for customers who sign up before end of Q2; finance + growth to publish exact eligibility.
people-ops-bot: Action created: AH-177300-1 (startup-credits-policy) assigned to @leah; AH-177300-2 (rollback-drill) assigned to @jon; AH-177300-3 (demo-postmortem) assigned to @ash; AH-177300-4 (partner-blurb) assigned to @mira.
nash: demo postmortem ETA: Fri EOD. will include root cause, mitigation, and a short note for the FAQ.
leah: partner-facing blurb request: can someone add a 1-line "timing change" note to the partner slide pack? sales/legal asked.
mira: I'll add a one-line partner blurb and post in #partners before EOD.
jon: rollback drill runbook will link to canary dashboard and include the rollback playbook.
ops-bot: Automation: tracker items created at https://redwood.example.com/ah/actions/177300 (4 cards).
mira: final ask 1: if any owner needs more time, @mention me here and i'll update the tracker. Closing the thread for now, will reopen if blockers appear. :raised_hands:
